title: Credit and Collections Policy: Credits Standing on the Account When Payment Arrangements Default
content:
**Credit and Collections Policy — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements): credits standing on the account at a default**

**Clause.** Which credits standing on the member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule account are applied to the balance billed back at a default follows the account's payment record:

(i) where a late payment charge was billed in the three months ending on the default date and a returned payment was posted in the twelve months ending on that date, the latest bill's billing error correction credits and the credit balance carried into it are applied, the two together;

(ii) where a late payment charge was billed in those three months and no returned payment was posted in those twelve months, the latest bill's billing error correction credits alone are applied;

(iii) where no late payment charge was billed in those three months, no credit is applied.

**Terms.** The *latest bill* is the bill of the latest installment's billing period on the agreement. Its *billing error correction credits* are the bill credits posted for that billing period with the reason billing error correction. The late payment charges and returned payments are read across the whole service account.

| Late payment charge in the 3 months ending on the default date | Returned payment in the 12 months ending on the default date | Credits applied |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | correction credits of the latest bill, together with the credit balance carried into it |
| yes | no | correction credits of the latest bill only |
| no | yes | none |
| no | no | none |

*Hypothetical account:* a late payment charge billed six weeks before the default date and a returned payment posted nine months before. Line (i) governs. Had the return been posted fourteen months before, line (ii) would govern; had the late payment charge been billed four months before, line (iii) would.
